body:
CHIEF TOPOLOGY DECISION — the narrow story-output dependency codec -> view is approved.

Reason: view owns renderer-neutral report/projection/profile domain state; codec owns canonical encoders/decoders. The edge is acyclic in the current graph, avoids erasing typed basis/outcome values into Json or strings, and does not pull renderer/browser machinery into portable modules. StoryModelCodec remains the sole canonical StoryModel encoding; the new result/manifest codecs may reference its artifact but may neither wrap nor redefine semantic JSON.

Ceiling: this decision approves only that module edge. It does not approve the current uncommitted public vocabulary, factories, wire admission rules, source slice, candidate, or landing. Those remain blocked by the 17:51Z chief provenance review on bd-01M199WBM2YVZ3GVC2GA61TYCJ: admitted basis, profile satisfaction, and report receipt identity are caller-mintable. Public names and exact paths/gate will be authorized only with a repaired coherent slice and mutation courts. No new module or further dependency is authorized.
